question: Among all products sold in the United States with promo_id=999, considering only those cities whose sales increased by at least 20% from Q4 2019 (calendar_quarter_id=1772) to Q4 2020 (calendar_quarter_id=1776), which product that ranks in the top 20% of total sales has the smallest percentage-point change in its share of total sales between these two quarters?
sql:
WITH q4_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND s.time_id IN (
        SELECT time_id FROM times WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1772
    )
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
),
q4_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.cust_city,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND s.time_id IN (
        SELECT time_id FROM times WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1776
    )
    GROUP BY c.cust_city
),
qualifying_cities AS (
    SELECT q1.cust_city
    FROM q4_2019 q1
    JOIN q4_2020 q2 ON q1.cust_city = q2.cust_city
    WHERE 1.0 * (q2.total_sales - q1.total_sales) / q1.total_sales >= 0.20
),
product_sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    AND s.time_id IN (SELECT time_id FROM times WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1772)
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
product_sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as total_sales
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers c ON s.cust_id = c.cust_id
    WHERE c.country_id = 52790
    AND c.cust_city IN (SELECT cust_city FROM qualifying_cities)
    AND s.time_id IN (SELECT time_id FROM times WHERE calendar_quarter_id = 1776)
    AND s.promo_id = 999
    GROUP BY s.prod_id
),
product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        p.prod_id,
        COALESCE(ps1.total_sales, 0) as sales_2019,
        COALESCE(ps2.total_sales, 0) as sales_2020,
        COALESCE(ps1.total_sales, 0) + COALESCE(ps2.total_sales, 0) as total_sales
    FROM products p
    LEFT JOIN product_sales_2019 ps1 ON p.prod_id = ps1.prod_id
    LEFT JOIN product_sales_2020 ps2 ON p.prod_id = ps2.prod_id
    WHERE ps1.total_sales > 0 OR ps2.total_sales > 0
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        prod_id,
        sales_2019,
        sales_2020,
        total_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC) as rn,
        COUNT(*) OVER () as total_count
    FROM product_totals
),
top_20_percent AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked_products
    WHERE rn <= 4  -- top 20% of 21 products = 4
),
grand_total_2019 AS (
    SELECT SUM(sales_2019) as gt_2019 FROM product_totals
),
grand_total_2020 AS (
    SELECT SUM(sales_2020) as gt_2020 FROM product_totals
)
SELECT 
    t.prod_id,
    t.sales_2019,
    t.sales_2020,
    gt_2019.gt_2019,
    gt_2020.gt_2020,
    1.0 * t.sales_2019 / gt_2019.gt_2019 as share_2019,
    1.0 * t.sales_2020 / gt_2020.gt_2020 as share_2020,
    (1.0 * t.sales_2020 / gt_2020.gt_2020) - (1.0 * t.sales_2019 / gt_2019.gt_2019) as share_change
FROM top_20_percent t
CROSS JOIN grand_total_2019 gt_2019
CROSS JOIN grand_total_2020 gt_2020
ORDER BY share_change ASC
